image_description: A medium shot of a musician playing a bassoon. The subject is a person with glasses and short hair, wearing a white shirt, holding the dark wooden instrument diagonally across their body. The metal bocal is in their mouth. In the background, there are black music stands and another brass instrument (likely a tuba or euphonium) partially visible.
